_note: The slides on the map once per login, for everyone (src/components/onboarding/FirstTimeTour.tsx): each takes you somewhere to do something. A slide with a goal is left out once that goal is done.
together: This game is only fun with other players. Bring your friends!

slides.title: Explore jobs
slides.text: Companies across Dubai are hiring today. A job pays your rent and keeps your visa alive.

slides.title: Go to driving school
slides.text: Pass the eye test, theory and parking, get your license, then drive your own car around Dubai.

slides.title: Start a course
slides.text: Study at Academic City to unlock better jobs and better visas. Your first lesson takes minutes.

slides.title: Go to a club
slides.text: Dance, meet real players and make your first friends in Dubai tonight.

slides.title: Play with other players
slides.text: Ludo, chess and more, live against real people. Wins score points for the monthly tournament.
